card.name: Linking points in lists of abstract nouns
card.fires_on: Joining marks such as "and", commas and opening quotes, plus the start of a word like "hatched", in general web prose. It fires where the next word is an abstract or scholarly term such as aesthetics, scientific, commercial or technical.
